email.subject: Thank You for Your Application
email.body:
Greetings,
Thank you for submitting an application for the IT Operating Unit Director (IT@JH Client Technology Solutions) position. Your application has been received by the Talent Acquisition Team and is pending review. You may be contacted by a Johns Hopkins University representative to schedule an interview if your experience and qualifications are deemed a suitable match for the position.
We appreciate your interest and time in completing your application. For information on your status, you may check your profile page at any time for updates. To update your profile or see more openings at Johns Hopkins University, visit our Careers site at
hiring.jhu.edu
.
Thank you,
The Johns Hopkins University Talent Acquisition Team
